parts.text: Create a Node.js JavaScript script that determines whether any item in a JSON array contains any key whose value has more than one immediate child element. Treat an object value's own properties as its child elements and an array value's members as its child elements; primitive/null values have zero children. The check must recurse through every nested object and array inside every top-level array item. Report every violation with the top-level array index, structural path to the key, child count, and whether the value is an object or array. The script should accept the JSON file path as a command-line argument, print a clear machine-readable JSON result, and return a nonzero exit code when one or more violations exist. Produce the complete script, suitable for use against ChatMachines/TokenizerCalibration/agents-by-header-flattened.json.
